summary: Array of 320-byte streaming views (camera position + cull planes) that the stream loader uses for load priorities (ls::StreamSystemLoadHelper::ProcessLoadRequests iterates the query of this component, builds TCullPlanes from each element and calls ls::sse::CalculateLoadPriority with the element's position). Live: 5 samples, one element each.

fields.name: Position
fields.evidence: Toolkit GameEngine.dll+0xA19230 passes the element address as 'Vector3f const&' (camera position) to ls::sse::CalculateLoadPriority. Toolkit offset only.

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: not read in the functions examined

fields.name: Planes
fields.evidence: Toolkit: sse::CreateCullPlanes((Vector4f*)(elem+0x20), span, count) with count read from elem+0x120 (Toolkit offsets).

fields.name: NumPlanes
fields.evidence: Toolkit: count of planes passed to CreateCullPlanes, read at elem+0x120.

fields.name: field_124
fields.evidence: rest of the 0x140 stride, not read in the functions examined

fields.name: Views
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x3D07C50 allocates 0x10 bytes zeroed; destructor bg3.exe+0x3B742C0 -> bg3.exe+0x3B81AF0 reallocates with param*0x140 bytes (alignment 0x10) and copies elements 0x140 bytes apart (POD). Live: heap pointer at +0, capacity 1 / size 1 at +8/+C.

open_questions: Element member offsets come from the Toolkit build only (stride 0x140 is confirmed in bg3.exe); Toolkit iterates this component with a 0x18 storage stride, so its build may differ.
